source.notes: Scanned school paper with no text layer (only the icseboard.org watermark); OCR corrected against the page images. No school name is printed. Printed header: 2nd Term Examination, Class: VII, Subject: Science, Time: 2Hrs, Marks: 80; footer 'Std7/Science/7th Feb 2025/73'. Although the file is listed on icseboard.org under class 8 / biology, the paper itself prints Class VII, so this pack is filed as class 7. examYear 2025 is from the printed footer date (7th Feb 2025). The Science paper has Section A Biology (25 Marks), Section B Chemistry (30 Marks) and Section C Physics (25 Marks); one pack is built per section. The 80 marks and 2 hours apply to the whole Science paper. Group totals are kept as one entry (never split). Student ticks/handwriting on the scan are ignored. No answer key is printed. This pack holds Section B (Chemistry), 30 marks; listed marks total 30. The question on page 3 after Q7 has its number partly overwritten by handwriting; it is read as 8 (the next printed number is Q9). Equation subscripts in Q9 are printed as subscripts but stored flat; the paper prints 'H2' (not subscripted) in Q9 b).
